name: task_create
description: Create a Task or Goal. Task defaults to proposed and Goal to todo; omitted assignee is the current account. Goal permits an explicit null assignee and has no execution platform or dependencies. Supply tagIds as the complete Project tag UUID set.

dependsOn.description: Ordinary prerequisites only; disjoint from externalDependsOn. Supplying either replaces both classifications.

externalDependsOn.description: External prerequisites only; disjoint from dependsOn. Supplying either replaces both classifications.

tagIds.description: Complete Project tag UUID set; omit to preserve on update, or supply an empty array to clear.

name: task_show
description: Read the complete Task resource. Summary is default; full content is explicit and may be large. Includes ephemeral Session observation, freshness and send eligibility; partial observations retain Task data.

name: task_update
description: Atomically change fields and dependency classification. Omission preserves; null clears nullable fields. Supply tagIds as the complete Project tag UUID set.

ifVersion.description: Exact positive int64 decimal; omit only where current CLI reads a version before writing.

dependsOn.description: Ordinary prerequisites only; disjoint from externalDependsOn. Supplying either replaces both classifications.

externalDependsOn.description: External prerequisites only; disjoint from dependsOn. Supplying either replaces both classifications.

parentId.description: Omit to retain, null to clear, or a Goal UUID to assign.

tagIds.description: Complete Project tag UUID set; omit to preserve on update, or supply an empty array to clear.

name: task_set_status
description: Set Task status. For ordinary Tasks, cancelled is irreversible and satisfies dependencies. Explicit claimId is valid only for completing an owned active claim.

ifVersion.description: Exact positive int64 decimal; omit only where current CLI reads a version before writing.

name: task_delete
description: Soft-delete a Task. Existing stored data and attachments are retained. Deleting a Goal hides it and all its children without removing their parent links; active executions stop later through existing cleanup.

ifVersion.description: Exact positive int64 decimal; omit only where current CLI reads a version before writing.

name: task_properties
description: Read server property schemas or current Task property values.

name: task_set_property
description: Set one literal property from raw JSON or direct string valueText, using server validation.

ifVersion.description: Exact positive int64 decimal; omit only where current CLI reads a version before writing.

name: task_remove_property
description: Remove one literal property; absence differs from null or an empty array.

ifVersion.description: Exact positive int64 decimal; omit only where current CLI reads a version before writing.
